coordinates: landmarks 1-20: per-frame wrist-relative pixels / pixel palm length; landmark 0: wrist displacement from first valid frame / median pixel palm length
interpolation: linear coordinates, nearest binary flags, absent coordinates zeroed
static_method: one clean original; training-only repeat + Gaussian noise in palm lengths
grouping: source path with Roboflow .rf. siblings grouped
evaluation: one unaugmented sequence per accepted source

extraction.normalization: MediaPipe image landmarks: x/width, y/height, wrist-relative z at x scale
extraction.video_timeline: all decoded frames, constant FPS timeline; missing frames zero-filled
